newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Manila firms plan to buy 65,000T wheat - traders.
newsitem.headline: Manila firms plan to buy 65,000T wheat - traders.

text.p: Philippine firms plan to buy 65,000 tonnes of wheat for May or June shipment, Manila grains traders said on Friday.

Two traders said they have received price enquiries from three flour millers. "We have offered them U.S. wheat but they rejected all prices because they said these were too high," said a senior trader.
The other trader said the wheat buyers informed him that they would wait for prices to soften before firming up their orders.
"If U.S. wheat prices stay at current price levels the buyers may look at other origins like Canada," the trader said.
The Philippines buys most of its wheat requirements from the United States.
